run.executedVia: Playwright (automated), driving the /shiftpay Service Portal; every screen assertion cross-checked against the ServiceNow Table API.

case.title: The "Awaiting action" count contradicts the queue beneath it

steps.text: Open the manager approval queue on a month where the reportees' statuses differ.
Capture the stat strip, the tab badges and the table together — the contradiction is between three parts of one screen, so it has to be one image.
screenshots: C:\Users\patel\Documents\ServiceNow Work Project Docs\Personal AI Assisted\ShiftPay Clean Vibe coding\testing\automation\evidence\TC-SP-009\02-stat-strip-contradicts-the-queue.png

steps.text: Read all three, and the timesheet records that settle which of them is right.

records.label: Four readings of the same number

observations: The contradiction is visible in a single screenshot: the headline tile says 6 while the tab badge directly above it says 5 and the table below shows 5 row(s) a manager can act on.

CAUSE: the .shift-mgr__stat--lead tile is bound to c.data.counts.all rather than c.data.counts.submitted, so it reports the size of the team instead of the size of the queue. FIX: change the binding. One word.

PROVENANCE: this defect was introduced deliberately, and is committed to the repository and deployed to the instance, so that the pack demonstrates a failing manager-side case alongside the two genuine calendar findings. The template line carries a comment naming this case — do not "fix" it without updating TEST-CASES-SHIFTPAY.md, or the pack goes green for no visible reason.

It is cosmetic by construction. data.counts is display-only: nothing in handleAction, actionOne, actionMany or correctDay reads it, so the worst case is a wrong number on a tile and no write path is affected.

The rest of the manager widget is sound. selectedIds() scopes to the visible rows, toggleAll and allSelected follow it, actionOne re-checks authorisation and state per row, and fail() sets data.actionError AND raises the message — which is exactly what the employee calendar gets wrong in TC-SP-004.
expected: The "Awaiting action" stat tile equals the number of reportees whose timesheet is submitted for the displayed month.
It therefore agrees with the "Awaiting me" tab badge and with the number of actionable rows in the table.
actual: The "Awaiting action" tile reads 6, while the records hold 5 submitted timesheet(s) for July 2026.
The "Awaiting me" tab badge reads 5 and the table shows 5 actionable row(s) — both correct. The tile is the outlier.
case.verdictReason: The "Awaiting action" tile reads 6 where the records hold 5 submitted timesheet(s). It reports the number of reportees, not the number awaiting a decision, and so contradicts both the tab badge and the table on the same screen.
